title: Compare Dotted Version Numbers
description: Compare two version strings made of non-negative decimal revision numbers separated by dots. Compare revisions from left to right, treating missing trailing revisions as zero and ignoring leading zeroes within each revision. Return -1 if the first version is smaller, 1 if it is larger, or 0 if they are equal. Input: `version1`, `version2`. Output: -1, 0, or 1.
constraints: Each revision contains at least one decimal digit
A version has at most 1000 revisions
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
